statement: A date that is not a real YYYY-MM-DD calendar date (such as 2025-02-30, 2025-13-01 or 2025-1-5) is rejected with InvalidDateError, and nothing is stored.

faults.description: The strict YYYY-MM-DD format check is removed, so '2025-1-5' is parsed as a valid date and accepted.
Date validation is no longer called when a check-in or freeze is recorded, so impossible dates such as 2025-02-30 are stored.

statement: The current streak counts consecutive check-in days ending today, or ending yesterday when today has no check-in, and is 0 when neither day has a check-in.

faults.description: The yesterday branch is disabled, so a streak that ended yesterday is reported as 0 instead of staying alive.
'Yesterday' is computed as two days ago, so a streak ending the day before today is dropped and one ending two days ago is wrongly kept alive.

statement: A single freeze day between two check-ins keeps the streak unbroken without adding to its length, while two or more consecutive days without check-ins (frozen or not) break it.

faults.description: The requirement that a check-in precedes the freeze day is dropped, so consecutive freeze days can bridge a gap of two days.
The frozen-day test is forced true, so any single unfrozen empty day is bridged as if it were frozen.
The check for a check-in before the freeze day looks at the freeze day itself, which never has one, so freeze days no longer bridge any gap.

statement: Weekly completion is the number of check-in days in the Monday-to-Sunday week containing the given date, divided by 7 and multiplied by 100, rounded to the nearest whole percent with halves rounding up.

faults.description: The percentage is truncated instead of rounded, so 3 check-ins give 42 instead of 43.
Only six days of the week are counted, so a check-in on Sunday is ignored.
The week starts at the supplied date instead of its Monday, so a mid-week date reports on the wrong days.

statement: Marking a date that already has a check-in as a freeze day is rejected with ConflictError, and a freeze day is not recorded as a check-in, so it does not count toward weekly completion.

faults.description: The conflict check is deleted, so a date with a check-in can also be frozen without error.
Freezing a date stores it as a check-in, so freeze days count as completed days in weekly percentages and streaks.
